Name: Derive Channels
Description: Add channels computed from existing ones with one "let <name> = <expression>" per line, e.g. let LRP = C3 - C4. A difference between electrodes is a channel operation, not a bin operation: bin arithmetic lives in DefineBins, channel arithmetic lives here (ERPLAB's chanoperator against its binoperator). Elementwise + - * / with parentheses, abs() and sqrt(), parsed directly and never eval-ed. Runs on continuous, epoched or averaged data; derived channels carry no scalp position, so they appear on ERP plots and in grand averages but are dropped from scalp maps
